newsitem.title: JAPAN: TSE says hard to specify reasons for volatility.
newsitem.headline: TSE says hard to specify reasons for volatility.

text.p: Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) president Mitsuhide Yamaguchi said on Tuesday that it was difficult to specify reasons for recent sharp fluctuations in share prices but that the TSE would closely watch the future move of share prices.
"The stock market recently repeated sharp rises and falls and it is extremely unstable," Yamaguchi said at a news conference.

"Some people say that the volatility is because of concerns over the future course of the Japanese economy and deteriorated demand-and-supply conditions in the market but it is difficult to specify the reasons. We will closely watch (the future move of the market)," he said.
